title: Work head positions after control steps
statement: Let $D,M_1,M_2$ be finite Boolean Turing machines and let $c$ be a configuration of $D$ on an input $x$. If $c$ is halted and its output is the one-bit word $[b]$, then for every $u\le 2$ there is an integer $z$ with $0\le z\le 1$ such that, after $u$ steps of the timed conditional machine started from the timed control configuration built from $c$, the work-tape head positions agree with the following: the first block has the head positions of $c$, the next block has all head positions zero, and the final head position is $z$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration of $D$ on input $x$
